sentence_text: This quiz covers all the lessons in this module.
A Ministry of Energy seeks to optimize off-grid investments in underserved rural zones but has limited household-level data.
Which of the following techniques could most effectively identify priority areas for electrification?
Cost–Benefit Analysis using national grid maps
Supervised Machine Learning using labeled access data and satellite imagery
Supervised ML trained on remote sensing and labeled access data can estimate electrification status and prioritize interventions.
Supervised ML trained on remote sensing and labeled access data can estimate electrification status and prioritize interventions.
Which of the following is a necessary condition for using energy data to support gender-transformative policy design?
Smart meter deployment in capital cities
Disaggregated data across gender, income, and location
Technical capacity in the private sector
Only disaggregated data can reveal energy access inequalities and support targeted, gender-responsive policies.
Only disaggregated data can reveal energy access inequalities and support targeted, gender-responsive policies.
You are supporting a PM&E strategy for a regional clean cooking program.
Which of the following indicators would provide actionable insights into intersectional equity?
LPG consumption in rural vs urban areas
Time poverty burden for women in woodfuel-dependent households
Time poverty reveals structural burdens faced by women and is critical for intersectional energy planning.
Time poverty reveals structural burdens faced by women and is critical for intersectional energy planning.
Which principle of the UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics is most directly threatened when private smart meter data is used without clear consent or anonymization?
Principle 4: Right to comment on misinterpretation
Using personal data without safeguards breaches professional ethics and undermines trust.
Using personal data without safeguards breaches professional ethics and undermines trust.
A government wants to use machine learning to target electricity subsidies.
What is a key ethical risk if training data is drawn only from urban consumers?
Overfitting the model to low-income contexts
Algorithmic bias reinforcing exclusion of rural and informal households
Model instability due to grid reliability
Biased training data can systematically exclude underserved groups, reinforcing inequality.
Biased training data can systematically exclude underserved groups, reinforcing inequality.
What is a key advantage of using prescriptive analytics over predictive analytics in energy transition planning?
It allocates capital expenditure in national budgets
It recommends specific actions based on predicted outcomes
Prescriptive models translate predictions into concrete decision pathways for planners.
Prescriptive models translate predictions into concrete decision pathways for planners.
In contexts where real-time monitoring is essential (e.g.
for distributed solar networks), what architecture is most effective to reduce latency and dependence on central servers?
Edge computing allows real-time, local processing critical for adaptive energy systems.
Edge computing allows real-time, local processing critical for adaptive energy systems.
A country has just adopted OSeMOSYS for long-term planning.
What is its main value for policymakers?
It visualizes renewable logos for public campaigns
It enables simulation of different energy policy scenarios and investment pathways
OSeMOSYS models techno-economic pathways under constraints and helps test policy impacts.
OSeMOSYS models techno-economic pathways under constraints and helps test policy impacts.
In institutionalizing data governance, what is the main value of establishing a regulatory sandbox in the energy sector?
It provides a safe space to test data-driven innovation under monitored conditions
Sandboxes let regulators and innovators co-design and test new energy data solutions before full implementation.
Sandboxes let regulators and innovators co-design and test new energy data solutions before full implementation.
